how_to_use.dose: One inbuilt flat plain spoon (approximately 3 g).
how_to_use.directions: Take one inbuilt flat plain spoon of supplement in the mouth, add warm water in the mouth, mix it well (like filling the mortar) and consume with cup of water.
how_to_use.timing: Take in the morning before breakfast and one hour before the dinner.
precautions: Pregnant women should avoid this product.

storage: Store in a cool and dry place.
